verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an official TypeScript SDK (`npm install @capacities/api`), and its new developer portal lists SDKs alongside an interactive OpenAPI spec with TypeScript SDK samples. Developers can also generate clients from the published OpenAPI 3.0 spec. The evidence is thin, though: only one language is shown, and the SDK sits on a new API generation that replaces a Beta API being discontinued. missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript, in-depth SDK reference documentation, evidence of SDK maturity and versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
